summary.text: Danny Williams is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 28 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Republican primary was canceled, and he lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Danny Williams earned a degree from Southern Nazarene University.
His career experience includes owning Statewide Communications, and he serves as board chairman of Seminole County Hope House.
Williams assumed office on November 18, 2020, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
In 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Children, Youth & Family Services Committee.
